He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.

translations.web: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
translations.bsb: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be uprooted.
translations.kjv: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out
translations.asv: But the wicked shall be cut off from the land, And the treacherous shall be rooted out of it.
